mapper.select: SELECT id, name, create_time, update_time, user_name FROM conversation where user_name=#{userName} ORDER BY update_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation (name, create_time, update_time, user_name) VALUES (#{name}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{userName})
INSERT INTO conversation_message (conversation_id, content, role) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{content}, #{role})
